paite: Pathian aw, hon hehpih in; mihing in hon valh khit atum uhi, nitum in hon sual in hon nuaisiah uh.
heading: David La / Pathian A Muanna Thumna Philistiate'n Gath Khua A Amat Lai Ua

paite: Ka melmate'n nitum in hon valh zoh atum ua, kisatheitak a hon sualte lah atam ngal ua.
Ka lau chiang in, nangmah ka hon muang hi.
Pathian ah athu ka phat ding a; Pathian ka gingta a, ka lau kei ding; sa in bang ahon chih thei dia!
Nitum in ka thute alakawi ua; angaihtuahna tengteng tuh ka siatna ding lam ngen ahi.
Akikhawm ua, abu ua, ka khapte achiamteh ua, ka hinna hihmang tum a angak ziak un.
Thulimlouhna in asuahtak san ding uam! Pathian aw, heh in michih hihniam in.
Nang ka vakvaihnate na chiamteh a, ka khituite na savun thawl ah thun in; na laibu ah atuang chiat kei ua hia!
K'on sap hun ngeingei in hon doute ataizak ding ua; hiai ka thei, Pathian in hon panpih hi.
Pathian ah athu ka phat ding a, TOUPA ah athu ka phat ding hi.
Pathian ka gingta a, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia!
Pathian aw, na kiang ah thuchiam ka nei a, kipahthugen kikhopnate in ka hon thuk ding hi.
Ka hinna sihna lak ah na humbit a; ka khete puk lou ding in na humbit kei a hia! Hinna vak a Pathian ma a ka paitheihna ding in.
